senses.gloss:
m. (-षः)
The month Pauṣa, (December-January.)
f. (-षी)
Day of full moon in the month Pauṣa.
E.
पुष्य the asterism in which the moon is full in this month, and अञ् aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Relating to a pond, to a lotus, to fragrant Costus, &c.
E.
पुष्कर, q. v., अण् aff.

f. (-णी)
A large pond or reservoir.
E.
पुष्करिणी the same, and अण् pleonastic aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Preservative, protective, nutritive, &c.
2 Nutritious, fattening.
n. (-कं)
A cloth worn when the ceremony of tonsure is performed.
E.
पुष्टि nourishing, and ठञ् aff.

n. (-ष्णं)
The last of the twenty-eight lunar asterisms; also REVATĪ.
E.
पूषन् the sun, in this name regent of the asterism, and अण् aff.

mfn. (-ष्पः-ष्पी-ष्पं)
Flowery, floral, relating or belonging to flowers, &c.
E.
पुष्प, and अण् aff.

n. (-कं)
The oxid of brass, considered as a collyrium.
E.
पुष्पक the same, and अण् aff.

f. (-ष्पी)
A name of Palibothra.
E.
पुष्प a flower, अण् aff., and ङीप् fem. aff.
